Evidence ID: P01F-P001
Source ID: P01F
B001 ID: B001-1
Witness Role: NT_GREEK
Passage Reference: Romans 4:3
Exact Source Text: τί γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει; Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην
1
.
Printed Page / Locator: Page 317
1
NotebookLM Citation:
1
Apparatus Present: NO
1
2
Apparatus Reading(s) & Witnesses: None
1
2
. The four collated editions (WH, Treg, NIV, RP) agree unanimously on this text
1
2
.
Textual Feature: The verse opens with the introductory question τί γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει; followed by the quotation clause containing the postpositive connective δὲ (Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ...)
1
.
Limitation: This source supplies only the critical Greek New Testament text and apparatus; it contains neither the Hebrew text nor the Septuagint of Genesis 15:6, and provides no commentary on translational or intertextual divergence.
P01F-P002
Evidence ID: P01F-P002
Source ID: P01F
B001 ID: B001-2
Witness Role: NT_GREEK
Passage Reference: Romans 9:25
Exact Source Text: ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ λέγει· Καλέσω τὸν οὐ λαόν μου λαόν μου καὶ τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην ἠγαπημένην·
3
Printed Page / Locator: Page 326
3
NotebookLM Citation:
3
Apparatus Present: NO
3
4
Apparatus Reading(s) & Witnesses: None
3
4
. All primary reference editions (WH, Treg, NIV, RP) print identical wording
3
4
.
Textual Feature: Contains an explicit prophetic attribution formula (ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ λέγει) followed by paired antithetical accusative designations (τὸν οὐ λαόν μου λαόν μου and τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην ἠγαπημένην)
3
.
Limitation: The source provides only the Pauline wording; it does not contain the Old Testament Hebrew or Septuagint text of Hosea 2:23, nor any notes explaining the selection or order of the clauses.
P01F-P003
Evidence ID: P01F-P003
Source ID: P01F
B001 ID: B001-3
Witness Role: NT_GREEK
Passage Reference: Romans 9:26
Exact Source Text: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη ⸀αὐτοῖς· Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς, ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ θεοῦ ζῶντος

Textual Feature: Text-critical variation exists over the presence of the dative pronoun αὐτοῖς before the direct quotation; the citation proper reads verbatim across all witnesses (Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς, ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ θεοῦ ζῶντος)
3
4
.
Limitation: The source establishes variation among modern printed editions regarding the introductory pronoun, but provides no Hebrew or Greek Old Testament witnesses for Hosea 1:10 (LXX Hos 2:1).

P01F-P004,P01F,B001-4,NT_GREEK,Romans 10:11,"λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή· Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐπʼ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται.",Page 327,[5],NO,None,"Formula λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή; initial universal quantifier Πᾶς modifying participle.","Supplies only Greek NT text; lacks Hebrew/LXX of Isa 28:16."

P01F-P007,P01F,B001-7,NT_GREEK,Romans 15:12,"καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει· Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν· ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.",Page 334,[8],NO,None,"Formula καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει; citation Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί...","Supplies only Greek NT text; lacks Hebrew/LXX of Isa 11:10 and textual comparison."
